known_secrets.text: Certain symbol clusters across the monument correspond to directional layouts in terrain.
These clusters repeat in a sequence that may represent movement instructions or spatial mapping.
Some inscriptions degrade in ways inconsistent with natural erosion.
This suggests selective alteration or removal.
I have identified at least one missing segment in the symbolic sequence.
This segment corresponds to areas near sealed or avoided structures.
Kalen is aware of structural anomalies that align with my missing segment theory, though he interprets them differently.
I have not fully disclosed my reconstruction model to Tarek or Nara.
